title: groupby.first() fails for np.datetime64 columns
body:
numpy 1.7 dev and pandas-0.8.2.dev_f5a74d4-py2.7-linux-x86_64

```
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
df = pd.DataFrame([(3,np.datetime64('2012-07-03')),(3,np.datetime64('2012-07-04'))], columns = ['a', 'date'])
df.groupby('a').first()
```
